passage.py: (Yī)

passage.zh: 曾有一項調查發現，很多員工生病的時候不敢請假，因為他們擔心老闆會不高興，覺得他們沒有責任感。
passage.py: Céng yǒu yíxiàng diàochá fāxiàn, hěnduō yuángōng shēngbìng de shíhòu bùgǎn qǐngjià, yīnwèi tāmen dānxīn lǎobǎn huì bù gāoxìng, juéde tāmen méiyǒu zérèngǎn.
passage.en: A survey once found that many employees don't dare to take sick leave when they are ill, because they worry their boss will be unhappy and think they have no sense of responsibility.

passage.zh: 有人認為，員工會這麼想是公司的責任。
passage.py: Yǒurén rènwéi, yuángōng huì zhème xiǎng shì gōngsī de zérèn.
passage.en: Some people believe that it is the company's responsibility that employees think this way.

passage.zh: 一個好的公司應該能照顧員工，而不是讓他們拿健康去換錢。
passage.py: Yí ge hǎo de gōngsī yīnggāi néng zhàogù yuángōng, ér búshì ràng tāmen ná jiànkāng qù huànqián.
passage.en: A good company should take care of its employees, not make them trade their health for money.

passage.zh: 因此，讓員工有幸福感，應該是未來企業努力的方向。
passage.py: Yīncǐ, ràng yuángōng yǒu Xìngfúgǎn, yīnggāi shì wèilái qǐyè nǔlì de fāngxiàng.
passage.en: Therefore, giving employees a sense of well-being should be the direction businesses work toward in the future.

stem.zh: 這篇文章說了什麼內容？
stem.py: Zhè piānwénzhāng shuō le shénme nèiróng?
stem.en: What does this passage talk about?

A.zh: 老闆應該給員工多一點兒假
A.py: Lǎobǎn yīnggāi gěi yuángōng duōyìdiǎnér jiǎ
A.en: Bosses should give employees a bit more leave.

B.zh: 常關心別人的人更有責任感
B.py: Cháng guānxīn biérén de rén gèng yǒu zérèngǎn
B.en: People who often care about others have a stronger sense of responsibility.

C.zh: 對公司有意見要勇敢說出來
C.py: Duì gōngsī yǒu yìjiàn yào yǒnggǎn shuō chūlái
C.en: If you have opinions about the company, you should bravely speak up.

D.zh: 照顧身體比認真工作更重要
D.py: Zhàogù shēntǐ bǐ rènzhēn gōngzuò gèng zhòngyào
D.en: Taking care of your health is more important than working hard.

passage.py: (Èr)

passage.zh: 如果你每天都覺得身體很累，有一份報告或許可以告訴你原因。
passage.py: Rúguǒ nǐ měitiān dōu juéde shēntǐ hěn lèi, yǒu yífèn bàogào huòxǔ kěyǐ gàosù nǐ yuányīn.
passage.en: If you feel physically tired every day, a report may be able to tell you why.

passage.zh: 這份報告提到了下面幾種可能：不愛運動、水喝得不夠多、總是把事情想得太壞、不吃早餐、吃太多沒營養的食物等。
passage.py: Zhèfèn bàogào tídào le xiàmiàn jǐzhǒng kěnéng: Bù ài yùndòng, shuǐ hē dé búgòu duō, zǒngshì bǎ shìqing xiǎng dé tàihuài, bùchī zǎocān, chī tài duō méi yíngyǎng de shíwù děng.
passage.en: The report mentions the following possibilities: not liking to exercise, not drinking enough water, always thinking the worst of things, skipping breakfast, eating too much non-nutritious food, and so on.

passage.zh: 以上幾點，只要簡單思考一下自己符合了幾項，再試著做出一些改變，想讓自己更健康一點也不難。
passage.py: Yǐshàng jǐdiǎn, zhǐyào jiǎndān sīkǎo yíxià zìjǐ fúhé le jǐxiàng, zài shìzhù zuòchū yìxiē gǎibiàn, xiǎng ràng zìjǐ gèng jiànkāng yìdiǎn yě bùnán.
passage.en: Just think briefly about how many of the points above apply to you, then try to make some changes; making yourself a little healthier is not hard.

stem.zh: 在改善健康方面，下面哪一個是作者的建議？
stem.py: Zài gǎishàn jiànkāng fāngmiàn, xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì zuòzhě de jiànyì?
stem.en: Regarding improving health, which of the following is the author's suggestion?

A.py: Yào péiyǎng yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn
A.en: Develop a good habit of exercising.

B.py: Xiǎngyào chī shénme jiù chī shénme
B.en: Eat whatever you want to eat.

C.py: Píngcháng yīnggāi duō zuò diǎn hǎoshì
C.en: You should usually do more good deeds.

D.en: Don't drink water after eating breakfast.

passage.py: (Sān)

passage.zh: 從前有一個地方很久都不下雨，人們不管怎麼求雨都沒有用。
passage.py: Cóngqián yǒu yí ge dìfāng hěnjiǔ dōu búxiàyǔ, rénmen bùguǎnzěnme qiúyǔ dōu méiyǒu yòng.
passage.en: Once upon a time there was a place where it hadn't rained for a very long time, and no matter how people prayed for rain, it was no use.

passage.zh: 有一次，他們從很遠的地方，請來一位有智慧的老人，希望他可以幫幫忙。
passage.py: Yǒu yícì, tāmen cóng hěnyuǎn de dìfāng, qǐnglái yíwèi yǒu Zhìhuì de lǎorén, xīwàng tā kěyǐ bāngbāngmáng.
passage.en: One time, they invited a wise old man from far away, hoping he could help them.

passage.zh: 老人在附近走了走、看了看，然後告訴他們，請蓋一間小屋，讓他住進去三天，三天當中，他任何人都不見。
passage.py: Lǎorén zài fùjìn zǒu le zǒu, kàn le kàn, ránhòu gàosù tāmen, qǐnggài yìjiān xiǎowū, ràng tā zhù jìnqù sāntiān, sāntiān dāngzhōng, tā rènhérén dōu bújiàn.
passage.en: The old man walked around the area and looked around, then told them to build a small hut and let him live in it for three days; during those three days he would see no one.

passage.zh: 結果，三天後真的下雨了。
passage.py: Jiéguǒ, sāntiān hòu zhēnde xiàyǔ le.
passage.en: As a result, three days later it really did rain.

passage.zh: 大家都問他是怎麼做到的，他只回答，只要自己的心安靜了，外面就安靜了，所以下雨了。
passage.py: Dàjiā dōu wèn tā shì zěnme zuòdào de, tā zhǐ huídá, zhǐyào zìjǐ de xīn Ānjìng le, wàimiàn jiù Ānjìng le, suǒyǐ xiàyǔ le.
passage.en: Everyone asked him how he had done it. He only answered that as long as one's own heart is calm, the outside becomes calm too, and so it rained.

stem.zh: 這個故事告訴了我們什麼事？
stem.py: Zhè ge gùshì gàosù le wǒmen shénme shì?
stem.en: What does this story tell us?

A.zh: 先照顧自己，才能幫助別人
A.py: Xiān zhàogù zìjǐ, cáinéng bāngzhù biérén
A.en: Take care of yourself first; only then can you help others.

B.zh: 想改變環境，就先改變心情
B.py: Xiǎng gǎibiàn huánjìng, jiùxiān gǎibiàn xīnqíng
B.en: If you want to change your surroundings, first change your state of mind.

C.zh: 年輕人應該要學會尊敬老人
C.py: Niánqīngrén yīnggāi yào xuéhuì zūnjìng lǎorén
C.en: Young people should learn to respect the elderly.

D.zh: 聰明的人知道什麼時候下雨
D.py: Cōngmíng de rén zhīdào shénme shíhòu xiàyǔ
D.en: Smart people know when it will rain.

passage.py: (Sì)

passage.zh: 說到錢，每個人對它的想法、使用方式和重視程度都不一樣。
passage.py: Shuō dào qián, měi ge rén duì tā de xiǎngfǎ, shǐyòng fāngshì hé zhòngshì chéngdù dōu bù yíyàng.
passage.en: When it comes to money, everyone's ideas about it, way of using it, and how much they value it are different.

passage.zh: 有人說：「錢是沒有性格的，它在誰的手上就像誰」。
passage.py: Yǒurén shuō: “Qián shì méiyǒu xìnggé de, tā zài shuí de shǒushàng jiù xiàng shuí”.
passage.en: Someone said: "Money has no personality; it resembles whoever's hands it is in."

passage.zh: 這句話說得很有道理，人們因為對錢的看法不同，而選擇不同的生活方式。
passage.py: Zhè jù huà shuō dé hěn yǒu dàolǐ, rénmen yīnwèi duì qián de kànfǎ bùtóng, ér xuǎnzé bùtóng de shēnghuó fāngshì.
passage.en: This saying makes a lot of sense: because people view money differently, they choose different ways of life.

passage.zh: 比方說，有的人喜歡看到銀行裡的數字不斷增加，所以每天努力工作，很少花錢；
passage.py: Bǐfāngshuō, yǒu de rén xǐhuān kàndào yínháng lǐ de shùzì búduàn zēngjiā, suǒyǐ měitiān nǔlì gōngzuò, hěnshǎo huāqián;
passage.en: For example, some people like to see the numbers in their bank account keep growing, so they work hard every day and seldom spend money;

passage.zh: 有的人覺得錢只要夠用就好，不必太在意工作，因為「自己的時間」，也是一種看不到的「錢」。
passage.py: Yǒu de rén juéde qián zhǐyào gòuyòng jiù hǎo, búbì tài zàiyì gōngzuò, yīnwèi “Zìjǐ de shíjiān”, yě shì yìzhǒng kànbúdào de “Qián”.
passage.en: others feel that as long as they have enough money it's fine, and they don't need to care too much about work, because "one's own time" is also a kind of invisible "money".

stem.zh: 這段話說了下面哪件事？
stem.py: Zhèduànhuà shuō le xiàmiàn nǎjiàn shì?
stem.en: Which of the following does this passage say?

A.en: Money is more important than anything.

B.en: Money can solve every problem.

C.zh: 人人有自己對錢的看法
C.py: Rénrén yǒu zìjǐ duì qián de kànfǎ
C.en: Everyone has their own view of money.

D.zh: 錢得放在銀行裡才有價值
D.py: Qiándé fàngzài yínháng lǐ cái yǒu jiàzhí
D.en: Money only has value if it is kept in the bank.

passage.py: (Wǔ)

passage.zh: 以前，電影院的門口常常出現一個牌子，要觀眾別帶外面買的食物進去，如果想吃東西，只能買電影院裡賣的食物。
passage.py: Yǐqián, diànyǐngyuàn de ménkǒu chángcháng chūxiàn yí ge páizi, yào guānzhòng bié dài wàimiàn mǎi de shíwù jìnqù, rúguǒ xiǎng chī Dōngxi, zhǐnéng mǎi diànyǐngyuàn lǐ mài de shíwù.
passage.en: In the past, signs often appeared at cinema entrances telling audiences not to bring in food bought outside; if they wanted to eat, they could only buy the food sold inside the cinema.

passage.zh: 後來，新聞說，觀眾其實可以拒絕配合這些電影院的規矩。
passage.py: Hòulái, xīnwén shuō, guānzhòng qíshí kěyǐ jùjué pèihé zhèxiē diànyǐngyuàn de guījǔ.
passage.en: Later, the news said that audiences could actually refuse to follow these cinema rules.

passage.zh: 說到這個問題，我認為，電影院的要求不是沒有道理，因為電影結束以後，他們還得打掃那些垃圾。
passage.py: Shuō dào zhè ge wèntí, wǒ rènwéi, diànyǐngyuàn de yāoqiú búshì méiyǒu dàolǐ, yīnwèi diànyǐng jiéshù yǐhòu, tāmen hái dé dǎsǎo nàxiē lājī.
passage.en: On this issue, I think the cinemas' request is not unreasonable, because after the movie ends they still have to clean up all that trash.

passage.zh: 其次，如果有人帶了一些有奇怪味道的食物進電影院，也很容易影響其他看電影的人。
passage.py: Qícì, rúguǒ yǒurén dài le yìxiē yǒu qíguài wèidào de shíwù jìn diànyǐngyuàn, yě hěn róngyì yǐngxiǎng qítā kàn diànyǐng de rén.
passage.en: Secondly, if someone brings food with a strange smell into the cinema, it can easily affect other moviegoers.

stem.zh: 作者對在電影院裡吃東西的行為怎麼看？
stem.py: Zuòzhě duì zài diànyǐngyuàn lǐ chī Dōngxi de xíngwéi zěnme kàn?
stem.en: What does the author think about eating in the cinema?

A.zh: 應該要避免吃有特別味道的東西
A.py: Yīnggāi yào bìmiǎn chī yǒu tèbié wèidào de Dōngxi
A.en: One should avoid eating food with a strong smell.

B.zh: 覺得吃什麼東西都是個人的自由
B.py: Juéde chī shénme Dōngxi dōu shì gèrén de zìyóu
B.en: What to eat is everyone's personal freedom.

C.zh: 認為電影院的要求沒有任何道理
C.py: Rènwéi diànyǐngyuàn de yāoqiú méiyǒu rènhé dàolǐ
C.en: The cinemas' request makes no sense at all.

D.zh: 看電影的人都有責任要打掃垃圾
D.py: Kàn diànyǐng de rén dōu yǒu zérèn yào dǎsǎo lājī
D.en: Everyone watching a movie is responsible for cleaning up trash.
